scope: Six international competitor samples: Easybrain, Oakever, Brainium, Andoku, Guru, GamoVation. Not a national popularity/download ranking. Language parameters do not prove region-exclusive or native-language copy; per-source fallback notes are authoritative.
method: Sampled public descriptions only, including public short copy when supplied. Web descriptions delimited by the actual game-description and update headings; direct HTTPS fallbacks use primary-app description only, excluding related-app data. Titles, tags, reviews, screenshots, linked sites and related-app cards excluded; URLs/emails inside description retained. NFC, lowercase, whitespace/apostrophe/dash normalization. Chinese/Thai use continuous substrings without segmentation; others use letter/mark/number boundaries, keeping combining marks inside words. Turkish I/İ case handled explicitly. Inflections, accents and synonyms distinct. Nested phrases may overlap. Full competitor prose not persisted in repository.

terminologySources.use: English rule semantics cross-check only; no claim of a native-language rule translation. Native terms checked against sampled publisher descriptions and visible localized APK UI.
